summary: @servicetitan/anvil-css-utilities preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as a CSS utilities library (dist/utilities.css). Its package.json declares preinstall running `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh GitHub releases and then executes a bundled `math_init.js` file under that runtime. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, string-array-obfuscated JavaScript bundle (WV8StW array-rotation, custom-alphabet `hc1jfK9` decoder) with no relationship to CSS. The tarball's declared manifest (`files: ["dist", "readme.md"]`, `main: index.js`) does not include `setup.mjs` or `math_init.js`, and the declared `main` (index.js) is not present — the only effect of installing this package is triggering the preinstall dropper. Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute the payload evades Node-based install-time inspection, and the advertised purpose (CSS classes) does not require any JavaScript execution, runtime download, or opaque payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
